title: 第4章 剧本不对啊！

content_zh:
“王子殿下，一切都准备好了，新生产的油式液压驻退装置绝对不会出现任何问题，至少不会在今天出现问题。”刚刚被授予爵士称号，勉强也能算一个贵族的德国工程师阿纳登豪塞尔擦了一把头上的汗水说道。这是他一鸣惊人走上人生巅峰的关键一步。这位贵人提携了自己，并且给予他这个直接面对军队高层的机会，他自然要抓住他，不过让他感到汗颜的是，他暂时还无法彻底解决液压装置的漏液问题，所以着实捏着一把汗。
“殿下，我们是不是做的太过分了，对方是巴伐利亚亲王，是您的叔叔。这种行为非常不礼貌。”旁边的侍卫长施密特子爵小声说道。
“你就当这是一场演习吧。”看似平淡的回答中透出一丝的忐忑。老子也想正常的和自己的叔叔观摩一下新式武器啊，但是奈何有些技术问题还没有解决，比如说液压设备的漏液问题，比如说机枪的枪管烧蚀和过热问题。前者自然是因为密封和受力问题，而后者则是机枪换装了新式无烟发射药后，能量过大引发的问题。
如果有充足的时间的话，自己自然不希望弄个半吊子工程，但是自己的叔叔，利奥波德亲王可不是随叫随到的！人家这时候有时间来看看你是给你面子！作为巴伐利亚王室中最能打，并且参过战、立过功、深孚众望的王室将领，如果能说服他的话，别的不说，至少巴伐利亚军队中的换装问题就都能搞定！
非常时期行非常之法，如何技能体现出新式武器的优越性又能隐藏各种漏洞可是一个非常难办的问题。比如说，新式的油压速射炮正在射击的时候，突然漏液了你说怎么办？再比如说，机枪换装新式发射药后，打了一会后过热怎么办？这都是麻烦事。于是，绞尽脑汁的穿越者想了这么一个办法......。
“殿下，亲王和他的骑兵到了！”旁边的一名军官指着远处的山丘上突然竖起了一面红旗说道，这意味着今天客人们已经到了距离这里越8公里左右的距离了，留给自己的时间不多了！、
“看到骑兵后，先用2门火炮发射空包弹，如果出现故障的话，在亲王殿下到来之前立即把另外2门火炮拉上来，叔叔，鲁普雷希特也感到压力很大啊！“有的时候，为了达到目标需要不择手段，嗯，就这样！”穿越者心中这样安慰自己......。
“尊敬的亲王殿下，为了防止出现一些意外，我们必须保证您和您的部下推掉步枪中的所有实装子弹，接下来的情况可能会出现一些意外，但是我可以保证，这一切都是安全的，这里是皇家猎场，外面还有军队负责安全保卫工作，这只是一场演习。”为了防止出现意外，便宜老爸最后还是让自己的大管家谢林伯爵负责和亲王沟通。而在一路上，谢林已经说了不下3次了，眼看大戏要开始了。他还是捏着一把汗。
“那个小家伙真是越来越滑头了！十岁之前挺耿直的一个人，十岁之后怎么就那么多古怪的想法？”利奥波德亲王微微一笑，不但命令手下的巴伐利亚骑兵师的士兵将子弹全部推掉，同时将马刀也交给不参加演习的人。
“我亲爱的侄子想要提前领教一下战争的艺术是一件好事，我怎么不支持呢？为了让他充分的体会真正战场上的情景，我专门做了一些布置，希望他能喜欢！”亲王嘴角浮现了一丝残忍的笑意。
“谢林伯爵，我记得你应该参加过普法战争吧？那时候你应该是个骑兵连长，是这样吗？”亲王若有所思的说道。
“是这样的，殿下，当时我的连队在您的炮兵掩护下突破了法国人的阵地。并因此获得了巴伐利亚骑士勋章。”谢林伯爵微微一愣，心想，这位亲王现在又想耍什么花招了？“现在演习时间已经开始了，您和您的骑兵需要投入战场了！”

content_en:
"Your Highness, everything is ready. There will definitely be no problems with the newly produced oil-type hydraulic holding and retreating device, at least not today." Anadenhauser, a German engineer who had just been awarded the title of knight and could barely be considered a noble, said as he wiped the sweat from his head. This was a key step in his meteoric rise to the top of his life. This noble man promoted him and gave him the opportunity to directly face the top military officials. Naturally, he wanted to seize him. However, what made him feel ashamed was that he could not completely solve the leakage problem of the hydraulic device for the time being, so he was really worried.
"Your Highness, have we gone too far? The other party is the Prince of Bavaria and your uncle. This behavior is very impolite." Viscount Schmidt, the captain of the guard next to him, whispered.
"Just think of it as an exercise." There was a trace of uneasiness in the seemingly plain answer. I also want to observe the new weapons with my uncle normally, but some technical problems have not been solved yet, such as the leakage problem of hydraulic equipment, and the problem of machine gun barrel ablation and overheating. The former is naturally due to sealing and stress issues, while the latter is a problem caused by excessive energy after the machine gun is equipped with a new smokeless propellant.
If he had enough time, he would naturally not want to do a half-baked project, but his uncle, Prince Leopold, was not always available! If people have time to come and see you at this time, it’s to give you face! As the most capable royal general in the Bavarian royal family, who has participated in battles, made meritorious deeds, and is highly regarded by the public, if he can be persuaded, if nothing else, at least the issue of dressing up in the Bavarian army can be solved!
In extraordinary times, extraordinary measures are adopted. How to demonstrate the superiority of new weapons while hiding various loopholes is a very difficult problem. For example, what would you do if a new hydraulic rapid-fire gun suddenly leaks fluid while it is shooting? For another example, what should I do if the machine gun overheats after being fired for a while after being replaced with a new propellant? This is all trouble. So, the time traveler who racked his brains came up with this idea...
"Your Highness, the prince and his cavalry have arrived!" An officer nearby pointed to a red flag that suddenly erected on the hill in the distance. This means that today the guests have reached a distance of about 8 kilometers from here, and there is not much time left for themselves! ,
"After seeing the cavalry, first use 2 artillery to fire blank ammunition. If there is a malfunction, immediately pull up the other 2 artillery before His Royal Highness the Prince arrives. Uncle, Ruprecht also feels a lot of pressure! "Sometimes, in order to achieve the goal, you need to do whatever it takes, well, that's it! "The time traveler comforts himself in this way..."
"Dear His Royal Highness, in order to prevent some accidents, we must ensure that you and your men push down all the live bullets in the rifles. There may be some accidents in the next situation, but I can guarantee that everything is safe. This is a royal hunting ground, and there are troops outside responsible for security. This is just an exercise. "In order to prevent accidents, Cheap Dad finally asked his butler, Earl Schelling, to be responsible for communicating with the prince. Along the way, Schelling had already said it no less than three times, and he was still sweating when he saw that the drama was about to begin.
"That little guy is getting more and more naughty! I was a very upright person before I was ten years old. Why do I have so many weird ideas after I turned ten? "Prince Leopold smiled slightly, and not only ordered his soldiers of the Bavarian Cavalry Division to push away all the bullets, but also gave the sabers to those who did not participate in the exercise.
"It's a good thing that my dear nephew wants to learn the art of war in advance. Why don't I support it? In order to let him fully experience the scene on the real battlefield, I specially made some clothI hope he likes it! "A cruel smile appeared on the prince's lips.
“Count Schelling, I remember that you should have participated in the Franco-Prussian War, right? You should have been a cavalry company commander at that time, right? "The prince said thoughtfully.
"That's right, Your Highness, at that time my company broke through the French position under the cover of your artillery. He was awarded the Bavarian Knight's Order. "Earl Schelling was stunned for a moment, thinking, what tricks does the prince want to play now? "Now that the exercise time has begun, you and your cavalry need to go to the battlefield! "
